title: Aircraft Finance Advisory
summary: Service page for Silver Oak Capital's senior secured aircraft finance advisory. Search results (a) and (b) both returned the page under the title 'Aircraft Finance Advisory' but only in truncated/summarised form. According to the search tool's summaries, the page describes senior secured aircraft finance as a loan where the borrower pledges the aircraft as first-ranking security, presents it as the lowest-risk form of aircraft finance sitting at the top of the capital stack, lists lender types (commercial banks, specialist aviation lenders, institutional lenders, private credit funds), says cost depends on aircraft age and type, borrower financial standing and how the aircraft is used, notes that older aircraft (roughly 20 to 25 years old) are harder and more expensive to finance, and lists uses as acquisitions, refinancing and debt restructuring. Related aviation pages surfaced: /aviation-finance/, /aviation-finance-lease-advisory/, /aviation-operating-lease-finance-advisory/, /case-studies/aircraft-loan-falcon-900/ (70% LTV, 4.45% fixed, 72 months, Dubai-based client) and /case-studies/top-aviation-firms/. Age-based LTV bands, 3-12 year terms and 4-12 week timelines were attributed by the search tool to 'the FAQ page', not confirmed as text of the target page. Search (c) returned no Silver Oak Capital content at all. No H1, meta description, literal page sentences, fees, process steps, testimonials or calls to action were revealed. The seed file contains no first-pass snippet for this path.
